result.instructions: Tools for Spreaker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my Spreaker shows."; "Which episodes of my show got the most plays last month?"; "Where do the listeners of my newest episode come from?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spreaker data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spreaker_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spreaker_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spreaker_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spreaker_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spreaker_get_me
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in Spreaker user (user_id, name, plan, organization_id). Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_list_shows
tools.title: List shows
tools.description: List the shows of a user. Without user_id, lists the signed-in user's own shows. Read-only.

filter.description: editable lists drafts too; own shows only. Default editable for the signed-in user.

tools.name: spreaker_get_show
tools.title: Get a show
tools.description: Get one show: title, description, categories, language, contact data. Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_list_episodes
tools.title: List episodes of a show
tools.description: List the episodes of a show, newest first by default. Read-only.

filter.description: editable includes drafts and scheduled episodes (own shows).

tools.name: spreaker_get_episode
tools.title: Get an episode
tools.description: Get one episode with its counts (plays, downloads, likes), visibility and show. Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_list_chapters
tools.title: List episode chapters
tools.description: List the chapters of an episode. Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_list_messages
tools.title: List episode comments
tools.description: List the listener messages (comments) of an episode. Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_get_show_statistics
tools.title: Get show totals
tools.description: All-time plays, downloads and episode count of a show. Needs the show owner. Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_get_episode_statistics
tools.title: Get episode totals
tools.description: All-time plays, downloads, likes and messages of an episode. Needs the owner. Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_get_play_statistics
tools.title: Get plays over time
tools.description: Plays and downloads of a show or an episode between two dates, grouped by day, week or month. Read-only.

group.description: Group the data by day, week or month.

tools.name: spreaker_get_episode_totals
tools.title: Get plays per episode
tools.description: Total plays and downloads of each episode of a show between two dates (paged). Read-only.

tools.name: spreaker_get_audience_statistics
tools.title: Get audience breakdown
tools.description: Where listeners come from for a show or an episode: sources, devices or operating systems, between two dates. Countries (geographics) work for shows only. Read-only.

group.description: Group the data by day, week or month.

tools.name: spreaker_update_episode
tools.title: Update episode details
tools.description: WRITE: change the title, description, tags or visibility of an episode you own. Only the fields you send change. Setting visibility PUBLIC publishes the episode. Does not touch the audio.
